product.title: 9-Line Waterfall Zipline Experience on the Big Island

description.text: See the Big Island from a different angle on this 9-line zipline adventure near Kona that takes you over tree tops, waterfalls, and rivers. Four dual lines let travelers zip side by side across the course. Stops include Umauma Experience Check-In, Waterfall Zipline Course, Dual Racing Lines, Pacific Ocean Viewpoint Platforms. Platforms open toward Pacific Ocean views as the route moves through the Umauma landscape. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
